answer_1.quote: We use the extreme summarisation dataset (XSum; ...), which consists of BBC articles and accompanying single-sentence summaries ... Recent advances in neural decoders led to a number of single-document summarisation systems ... We propose a new evaluation metric ...

answer_2.quote: We introduce two metrics: Corr-F (fact-level) and Corr-A (argument-level). ... We compare our metrics against existing reference‑based ROUGE and BERTScore, as well as the referenceless manual HROUGE score.

answer_4.quote: We collect manual content highlights on fact and argument levels, where we present human judges with the source document and the gold summary, with one fact/argument typeset in bold. The judges are required to select phrases or sentences in the document that support the bolded fact/argument ... We employ 3 judges per document in both cases.
answer_4.guideline: Present source document and gold summary with bolded fact/argument; ask annotators to select supporting text spans in the document.
